milestone.describes: A real-time battle is under way: a unit has been selected and spawned onto a lane, and the battle renders and keeps running.

steps.expect: The main menu. The note allows about 15 s.
The mode menu, with Campaign on it.

steps.from: the Continue Campaign / New Campaign / Back menu, which only appears when a campaign save exists
steps.expect: Choose Your Race. On a fresh profile this screen never appears and Campaign goes straight there.
The strategic campaign map: Risk-style territories with armies on them.
The panel for the territory "Vorth", with Attack on it.
The battle screen, with a tutorial overlay over it.
The overlay is dismissed and the battlefield is visible.
The spear unit is selected in the unit bar.
The unit spawns onto that lane and joins the combat. The battle renders and persists, which is the milestone.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 1024x768 landscape-native window.

`--landscape-native` is required and is already set for this bundle in tapHLE_default_options.txt. It is not a presentation flag: this app is a landscape-native renderer, so with a portrait-shaped emulated screen it draws rotated and clipped. `--landscape-left`, `--landscape-right` and `--force-composition` do not fix that — they keep the portrait framebuffer.
Play and Campaign sit three pixels apart vertically on two different screens. That is not a typo: they are separate menus that happen to place their first entry in almost the same place.

**The save-state divergence is real and this map hit it.** The route was first recorded on a fresh profile, where Campaign leads straight to Choose Your Race. Replayed on 2026-08-17 against a profile with a campaign save, Campaign instead offered Continue Campaign / New Campaign / Back, every later coordinate landed on that menu, and the replay sat there to the end. The `new-campaign` step exists for that case; Continue Campaign is at (200, 453) if you would rather resume than start over.

`--replay` inside tapHLE does not act on `requires_save_state` — it runs every step, so on a fresh profile it will tap (200, 549) on the Choose Your Race screen. `dev-scripts/clickmap.ps1` does honour the field, via -HasSaveState.
